verdict.rationale: RevenueCat documents a REST API with secret-key endpoints, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec. The probe found every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path returning 404. The llms.txt file and the MCP server are adjacent AI-facing features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
